description: Extract the public API surface of a TypeScript project as JSON, without comparing it to anything. Use it to see what a package exports; use semver_compare to decide a bump. The source can be a filesystem path, a git ref, or an npm spec, the same three forms semver_compare takes, with the same network and temp-directory behaviour. Returns {"entrypoints": {<subpath>: {<symbol>: <kind>}}}, with each symbol's full type shape in place of its kind when "detail" is set. Symbols stop at the "maxBytes" budget, and an "omitted" field then gives the number left out and the total. A source whose surface comes back empty is reported as an analysis_failed error, not as an empty result; pass "entry" to point at the declaration file.

detail.description: Include each symbol's full type shape instead of just its kind. A shape runs a median of about 370 bytes and a wide interface tens of kilobytes, against about 35 for a name and a kind, so a large package will hit the byte budget after a few dozen symbols.

entry.description: Entry file relative to project root (e.g. "src/index.ts"). Pass an array or a comma-separated string for a package with several entry points.

installDeps.description: Install dependencies before analysis. In a local path with no node_modules this runs "npm install --ignore-scripts" in that directory, and adds @types/node there if it is missing. Only a local path needs it: a git ref is always installed in its temp copy.

maxBytes.description: Byte budget for the symbols in the response (default 40000). Symbols are included while it lasts, and an "omitted" field then reports how many were left out along with the total. No symbol is exempt: under "detail" a single wide interface can cost tens of kilobytes, so a budget smaller than that returns no symbols and says so rather than overshooting. Only the entrypoint keys and the "omitted" field sit outside the budget, a few hundred bytes.

path.description: Project source: a filesystem path, a git ref, or an npm spec such as "lodash@4.17.21". Defaults to current directory.

pathAs.description: Force "path" to be treated as a filesystem path, a git ref, or an npm spec. "ref" is an accepted spelling of "git". Only needed when auto-detection would read the input as the wrong kind.

name: semver_snapshot
